purpose: Judge identity and scene preservation, realistic skin tones, integrated pink and magenta lighting, cinematic depth, and a polished luxury editorial finish.

examples.title: Explain the moody-pink grade in one glance
whyItWorks: The title, finished city portrait, and single original-photo inset explain the transformation immediately
The subject, clothing, street, and night composition stay recognizable
Pink and magenta light feels cinematic without flattening the image

examples.title: Keep a spontaneous group reaction readable
whyItWorks: All three faces, gestures, drinks, and bar details survive the grade
Realistic skin texture remains visible inside saturated ambient light
Reflections and glowing bulbs make the treatment feel motivated by the venue

examples.title: Carry pink light across a busy nightlife frame
whyItWorks: People, poses, glassware, clothing, and the crowded bar stay intact
Rich shadows preserve separation between overlapping subjects
The grade reads as a premium editorial instead of a simple color overlay

examples.title: Make a quiet portrait feel deliberately cinematic
whyItWorks: The face, hand, cigarette, clothing, booth, and wall remain recognizable
The practical wall light supports the new magenta atmosphere
Soft contrast and deep blacks preserve a restrained editorial mood

examples.title: Preserve every face in a candid group photo
whyItWorks: The source inset confirms the people, expressions, and composition stay recognizable
Pink light unifies the frame without erasing facial detail
The background remains photographic and spatially coherent

examples.title: Move the same palette into an open landscape
whyItWorks: Both people, clothing, shoreline, water, and horizon retain their structure
Atmospheric depth keeps the pink dusk from feeling flat
The treatment proves the recipe can work beyond nightlife interiors
